gate.memory_note: The queue bound excludes one producer and one consumer batch, chunker read-ahead, extents, compression state and existing store caches.
gate.design: Each sealing worker can spawn one scoped producer for reading, chunking and whole-file SHA-256. The existing worker performs chunk hashing, duplicate queries, compression and pack writes. Two queued batches of 16 chunks bound read-ahead. Small files and offline imports stay sequential.
gate.correctness: Serial and pipeline imports produce identical manifests, chunk identities and pack bytes, including rollover and edits. Producer I/O errors and panics cannot publish a manifest. Backpressured cancellation and premature finish join without deadlock. Existing source metadata and epoch checks and durable pack-before-catalog ordering remain.

limitations: Pipeline off/on use the same executable; the prior implementation controls for the refactoring itself.
Two reversed-order rounds on a shared node, not a statistical significance claim.
Warm OS caches; debug incremental only.
CPU idle observation does not prove background sealing drained.
Cumulative phase times overlap; they are not added Cargo latency.
Two workers in both SL7 cases; fixed source/profile/output paths; the enabled candidate overlaps large-file chunking and file hashing with chunk hashing, compression and pack writes.
